title: Group-Differentiated Discourse on Generative AI in High School Education: A Case Study of Reddit Communities
extended_summary:
This paper examines how Reddit communities discuss generative AI in high school education, with a focus on learning impacts, academic integrity, AI detection tools, and emotional framing. Rather than testing an instructional intervention, the study analyzes naturally occurring online discourse to understand how stakeholder position shapes attitudes toward classroom AI. The authors argue that teachers and students talk about the same technologies in systematically different ways because they occupy different roles in the educational system.

The dataset consists of 3,789 English-language Reddit posts and comments collected from five education-related subreddits between December 2022 and December 2024. The authors use keyword-based retrieval, human-validated relevance filtering, and LLM-assisted annotation to label posts for learning-related frames, integrity/enforcement, and emotions. They then compare student, teacher, and mixed communities using chi-square tests and effect sizes.

The main finding is that teachers are more likely to express explicit pedagogical trade-offs, framing AI as both helpful and harmful for learning, while students more often discuss AI in tactical terms related to accusations, grades, and enforcement. Detector-related discourse is associated with higher negative emotion across all groups, with stronger effects for students and mixed communities than for teachers. The paper concludes that AI detectors function as governance mechanisms that create emotional harm and that process-based assessment is a fairer alternative for academic integrity enforcement in AI-mediated classrooms.
quality_tier_rationale: This is a qualitative/correlational social media study using human-validated LLM annotation and chi-square analysis, not an intervention trial. It provides descriptive evidence about discourse and governance concerns, but no direct causal estimate of an educational treatment effect.
impact_tier_rationale: The paper reports meaningful but context-specific associations in Reddit discourse, especially around detector-related emotional harm, with effect sizes in the modest range. Its implications are important for policy and practice, but the study does not evaluate a classroom intervention or demonstrate direct student learning impact.

interventions.use_case: Reddit discourse analysis of generative AI in high school education, focusing on AI detectors, academic integrity enforcement, and perceived learning impacts rather than direct classroom implementation.

finding.finding_summary: Across 3,789 Reddit posts, the paper finds that stakeholder position strongly shapes governance discourse around generative AI in schools. Teachers more often articulate dual pedagogical trade-offs, while students discuss AI in enforcement and consequence terms; detector-related discourse is associated with higher negative emotion overall (+0.132 risk difference) and even more strongly among students (+0.194).
finding.measure: Topic- and emotion-labeled Reddit posts; chi-square tests of group differences; risk difference for negative emotion in detector-related posts
